svg.title: HTTP request inspection
svg.desc: Requests and responses travel from a browser HTTP client through the shield for inspection. Header and body inspection precede the decision. Allowed requests reach protected CMS, REST API, SaaS and database services and receive a 200 OK response; blocked requests stop, receive a 403 response and create an audit entry. A GET response containing a data leak is blocked during phase 4 response-body inspection when configured. These are illustrative rule decisions, not a live traffic display.
